english.title: Aid / abet controller / manager of house in multiple occupation to act without a section 61(1) licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled or procured, **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who had control of or managed a House in Multiple Occupation which was required to be licensed under Part 2 of the Housing Act 2004, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), but which was not so licensed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72(1) and (6) of the Housing Act 2004 and section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.
